decisions.relationship: 2 opening(s) and 1 screen(s) are authored on a wall whose neighbour decides what can stand there.
decisions.softwareRole: Derives the wall and position of any door or opening declared with host side "shared", and of a window declared "exposed" when exactly one exposed run exists; reports the exposed runs of every edge.

decisions.title: Independently placed rooms meet: media-lounge/east-suite-1, media-lounge/east-suite-1
decisions.relationship: Relative placement chains were authored without seeing where each ended.
decisions.softwareRole: Resolves every relative placement to absolute extents and reports each overlap.
decisions.modelDecides: Which chain yields or whether the rooms should meet.

decisions.title: Pitched roof on east-suite-3
decisions.relationship: A pitched roof (hip) stays inside its own room and builds fascia only on edges no other room shares, so abutting a neighbour of any height is valid. It is rejected only where a space is stacked over part of it (lean-to or valley), where an overhang reaches a neighbour, or where rooms overlap.
decisions.softwareRole: Derives, from adjacency alone, which edges of a pitched roof are exposed (fascia only there) and which neighbours it meets; builds the exposed remainder of a partly covered flat roof itself.
decisions.modelDecides: Which rooms get a pitched or overhanging roof (a design choice), a flat roof for any space with a room stacked over part of it, and the arrangement when rooms overlap.

signals.evidence: 12 of 30 interior rooms are identical cells in groups of three or more (6× 9×6 m; 6× 4×6 m).
30 interior rooms share one level; envelope tops span only 4.8 m (6 distinct heights); roof forms: flat, gable, hip.
2 level(s) for 30 interior rooms. A single level is not a defect on its own; this only contributes when combined with other signals.

15 of 30 interior rooms (31% of interior area) have no window: arrival-cloakroom, stair-hall, kitchen, pantry, laundry, service-store, east-private-hall, west-private-hall, east-bath-1, east-bath-2, east-bath-3, west-bath-1, west-bath-2, west-bath-3, upper-landing.
Allocated cells fill 73% of their 55×50 m bounding rectangle: an articulated footprint.
No obvious programme gaps among authored uses.
0 of 32 roofs carry an overhang (0 distinct values) irrespective of which edges are exposed.

disposition.note: Some architectural weakness is present but the concept is not judged fundamentally ordinary; physical relationships should be corrected while preserving coherent decisions, and the weaknesses reconsidered where cheap.
